description: This file is a PHP source file for managing the addition of a blocked domain site within a parental control web interface. It includes server-side PHP for condition checks and HTML/JavaScript for rendering a form UI that allows users to specify a URL, configure blocking options, set blocking times, select days, and submit the configuration via AJAX.
